faction.isekai_mahou.guild.desc: The organization that registers adventurers, hands out quests and pays for great deeds. Every completed quest raises your fame here.
faction.isekai_mahou.guild.perk.enemy: Adventurers attack you on sight and the Guild will not deal with you.
faction.isekai_mahou.guild.perk.hostile: The Guild shuts its doors: no trading and no contracts.
faction.isekai_mahou.guild.perk.neutral: Normal prices. Quests and promotions follow your Guild rank.
faction.isekai_mahou.guild.perk.friendly: Prices −5% with the Guild and adventurers.
faction.isekai_mahou.guild.perk.honored: Prices −10% and up to 3 hired companions at once.
faction.isekai_mahou.guild.perk.revered: Prices −20%. Your name is known in every Guild hall.
faction.isekai_mahou.guild.perk.exalted: Prices −30%. You are a living legend of the Guild.
faction.isekai_mahou.kingdom.desc: The human kingdom of Aldória: walled cities, guards, villages and the Lord in the capital. Defend the cities and commit no crimes.
faction.isekai_mahou.kingdom.perk.enemy: Guards and iron golems hunt you down, and nobody in the Kingdom will trade.
faction.isekai_mahou.kingdom.perk.hostil: Guards and iron golems attack you. Kingdom villagers and merchants will not trade.
faction.isekai_mahou.kingdom.perk.unfrie: Kingdom merchant prices +25%. The guards keep an eye on you.
faction.isekai_mahou.kingdom.perk.honore: Prices −10%. Talk to the Lord: he has a reward for you.
faction.isekai_mahou.kingdom.perk.revere: Prices −20%. Guards salute you at the gates.
faction.isekai_mahou.kingdom.perk.exalte: Prices −30%. Talk to the Lord to be named Hero of Aldória.
faction.isekai_mahou.academy.desc: The scholars of magic. They value cleared Trials, research and elemental mastery (+10 for every Trial won).
faction.isekai_mahou.academy.perk.enemy: The Academy has named you an enemy of magic: no mage or scribe will speak to you.
faction.isekai_mahou.academy.perk.hostil: Wandering mages and scribes refuse to trade with you.
faction.isekai_mahou.academy.perk.unfrie: Prices +25% with scribes and wandering mages.
faction.isekai_mahou.academy.perk.friend: Prices −5%. Scribes unlock more advanced glyph scrolls.
faction.isekai_mahou.academy.perk.honore: Prices −10%. More glyph scrolls for sale.
faction.isekai_mahou.academy.perk.revere: Prices −20%. Scribes open the library's restricted section.
faction.isekai_mahou.church.desc: The faith of the Dawn: priests heal, purify and fight the undead. Sworn rival of the Underworld.
faction.isekai_mahou.church.perk.enemy: The Church has declared you a heretic: no services, no blessings.
faction.isekai_mahou.church.perk.hostile: The Church shuts its doors: no services, no trading.
faction.isekai_mahou.church.perk.neutral: Normal services: healing, cleansing conditions and curses, Blessing of the Dawn.
faction.isekai_mahou.church.perk.revered: Services and offers −20%. The Dawn acknowledges your faith.
faction.isekai_mahou.church.perk.exalted: Services and offers −30%. You are a Herald of the Dawn.
faction.isekai_mahou.underworld.desc: Thieves, fences and night contracts. Helping the Underworld costs you the trust of the Church and the Kingdom.
faction.isekai_mahou.underworld.perk.ene: The Underworld has marked you: no fence will deal with you.
faction.isekai_mahou.underworld.perk.hos: The fences pretend not to know you: no trading.
faction.isekai_mahou.underworld.perk.neu: The fence deals with you, no questions asked.
faction.isekai_mahou.underworld.perk.hon: Prices −10%. The shadows keep your secrets.
faction.isekai_mahou.underworld.perk.rev: Prices −20%. The Underworld answers when you call.
faction.isekai_mahou.underworld.perk.exa: Prices −30%. King of Shadows: the alleys obey you.
faction.isekai_mahou.wildfolk.desc: Fairies and nature spirits. Protect the forest and they stop attacking you.
faction.isekai_mahou.wildfolk.perk.enemy: The whole forest hunts you: nature spirits attack on sight.
faction.isekai_mahou.wildfolk.perk.hosti: Nature spirits attack you on sight.
faction.isekai_mahou.wildfolk.perk.neutr: Nature spirits attack strangers; fairies flee.
faction.isekai_mahou.wildfolk.perk.frien: Nature spirits leave you in peace (unless you attack).
faction.isekai_mahou.wildfolk.perk.honor: The forest recognizes you as a warden.
faction.isekai_mahou.wildfolk.perk.rever: The spirits speak to you as one of their own.
faction.isekai_mahou.wildfolk.perk.exalt: Heart of the Forest: all of nature is your ally.
faction.isekai_mahou.horde.desc: Clans of goblins, orcs and kobolds. Natural enemies of the Kingdom: slaying Horde members pleases the Kingdom.
faction.isekai_mahou.horde.perk.enemy: The Horde hunts you wherever you go.
faction.isekai_mahou.horde.perk.hostile: Goblins, orcs and kobolds attack you on sight.
faction.isekai_mahou.horde.perk.unfriend: The Horde attacks any stranger — including you.
faction.isekai_mahou.horde.perk.neutral: The Horde attacks any stranger. Only the Friendly pass in peace.
faction.isekai_mahou.horde.perk.friendly: Goblins, orcs and kobolds leave you in peace (unless you attack). Bosses still fight.
faction.isekai_mahou.horde.perk.honored: You are treated as a clan brother.
faction.isekai_mahou.horde.perk.exalted: King of the Horde: the clans bow before you.
reputation.isekai_mahou.chat.neutral_now: %s now leaves you in peace — unless you strike first.

reputation.isekai_mahou.warn.hostile: Careful: guards and members of %s will attack you!
reputation.isekai_mahou.warn.unfriendly: %s no longer trusts you: higher prices.
reputation.isekai_mahou.warn.neutral_los: %s no longer sees you as a friend: its members will attack again.
reputation.isekai_mahou.rewards.title: New title: %s (choose it in the Reputation tab)

screen.isekai_mahou.reputation.neutral_h: Members attack strangers, but leave you in peace from Friendly on (unless you attack).
